title: Martine Moise enters Haiti's first presidential election in a decade
summary_full: Martine Moise has officially entered the race for Haiti's upcoming presidential election set for July next year, marking a significant moment as it will be the first election in almost a decade. Amidst ongoing security concerns and political turmoil, Moise's candidacy is particularly poignant given her ties to recent events. With 33 candidates on the ballot, Haitian voters will face critical choices that could reshape the country's political future.
